name: Chlorophyll
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a green leaf)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours (D)

DESCRIPTION

Your skin takes on a green tint that allows you to draw energy from the sun. While under this spell you do not need to eat and can survive indefinitely while exposed to the sun, but you still require water and air.

Furthermore, while in direct sunlight you regain lost hit points at twice the normal rate through normal rest.
